comparisons.peer_topic: Acquisition of ZT Systems: Manufacturing Business Strategy
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD intends to seek a strategic partner to acquire ZT Systems' manufacturing business as part of the acquisition.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD disclose strategic shifts in their business models and manufacturing structures in 2024, but they focus on different operational mechanisms. Intel describes its 'internal foundry model' as a strategic component to reshape operational dynamics and drive transparency and efficiency within its existing structure. In contrast, AMD is pursuing an external strategic partnership to acquire manufacturing assets from ZT Systems, indicating a reliance on external expansion rather than just internal restructuring. While both involve 'manufacturing business strategy' and 'Strategy & Business Model' taxonomy, Intel's approach centers on internal operational transformation, whereas AMD's centers on acquiring external capabilities.
